quote: By combining accuracy comparisons, statistical methods, SHAP analysis, and embedding-based measures, we provide a holistic view of bias manifestation.

We calculated accuracy scores across dimensions like gender, ethnicity, model type, and prompt variations... We employed statistical metrics to quantify bias: i) Equality of Odds (EO)... ii) SkewSize... iii) Coefficient of Variation (CV)... We also evaluated the models' explanations through their sentence embeddings using SBERT... We used gender bias scores (BiasScore) derived from embedding differences.
